details:
I know many people who have very fancy and very personal custom avatars, either because they've made it themselves or because they've paid a lot of money to have it commissioned. One fear shared among all of these people is the idea of someone else using illegal third party tools to rip, steal, and reupload that person's avatar... and while there's no truly perfect method to prevent it, I believe that allowing people to instead stop others from being able to view (and by extension download) their avatar unless they are put on a personal whitelist will help the situation a significant amount.
Simply put, it will allow for peace of mind for people joining friends+, invite+, and even publics while they and their friends are able to see their own avatars while meeting and interacting with new people.
Obviously they could just not wear their custom avatars, but then what's the point in going to all that effort to get one if you can't use it?
The feature could potentially be expanded on even further by having a system that allows people to specify a default avatar to load for non-whitelisted players much in the same way users can specify PC avatars and fallback Quest avatars - so hopefully it wouldn't be hard to implement.
Once again I understand there will never be a perfect system in place to prevent theft from happening, but putting in more systems that allows for users to have greater control over their custom content could go a long way.
title: Avatar Viewing Whitelist for Other Players (aka "X person would like to view your avatar.")
